title: ⚡ Bolt: [performance improvement] Replace hot-path LINQ with loops in Temporal Simulation Engine
body:
💡 **What:** Replaced high-allocation LINQ chains (`.Where`, `.Select`, `.ToHashSet`, `.ToList`, `.ToDictionary`) with standard `foreach` loops in the critical simulation path (`Advance`, `ApplyTimelineEventOverlay`, and `SnapshotResourceOccupancy`) within `TemporalNetworkSimulationEngine.cs`.

🎯 **Why:** To eliminate repetitive, unnecessary GC pressure. LINQ creates underlying enumerators, delegate closures, and array allocations per call, which degrades performance notably within the inner engine simulation loops. Standard loops avoid these allocations while performing the exact same logic.

📊 **Impact:** Materially reduces the memory footprint and GC pauses for long-running temporal simulations, improving raw throughput of the `Advance` simulation cycle.

🔬 **Measurement:** Full test suite verified passing. The impact can be further measured via standard .NET allocation profiling against multi-step temporal networks, noting a steep reduction in `System.Action` and `IEnumerator` allocations.
